summary: You can now watch every committed change until it is live, and commits are faster.

new.title: Watch your changes go live
new.text: After you commit, a panel follows each change until it is live in Entra ID or Azure, or shows why it is waiting or failed.

fixes.title: Faster commits
fixes.text: A commit now saves only what really changed, so a small change in a large list commits much faster.
